title: Store documents as Markdown
text: Context The test repository needs one storage decision to prove the setup. Decision Store documents as Markdown with frontmatter in git. Consequences Every change is reviewed in a pull request.

title: Store documents as Markdown with checked frontmatter
text: Context Markdown alone (ADR-0001) does not give the documents a schema. Decision Documents are Markdown with YAML frontmatter that the validator checks (ADR-0001), on the approved runtime (TECH-0001). Consequences The validate check fails documents with bad frontmatter.

title: Node.js
text: Use Node.js runs the idc365-decisions CLI and its workflows. Version Node.js 24 LTS.
